area: California San Francisco Groundfish Management Area · 38°57.5′ N to 37°11′ N
scope: Recreational boat fishing on the outer coast; pending San Francisco source and legal review. No open-season claim is published.
common_notes: This draft covers the outer coast, not San Francisco Bay. Species seasons, method restrictions, MPAs and federal closures require separate legal review.
The September–October 2026 salmon opening described by CDFW begins at 38°02′ N; it cannot be generalized to Bodega-area water north of that line.
This draft does not confirm an open season or legal fishing position.
